descriptionMarkdown:
These are complete starting profiles for Dark Imperium. Weapons are defined in 21.11. Enclosed, Exposed and Open-
topped use the protection in 21.3. Sealed excludes normal airborne contaminants while closed and provides one hour 
of internal air; it does not grant voidworthiness or protect a breached hull. Capacities and statistics are conversion 
values for these representative loadouts.
Civilian Autocar
Large wheeled vehicle
AC 12 | HP 35 | DT 0 | Speed 60 ft | Handling +1
Crew 1 D | Passengers 3 | Cargo 250 kg | Controlled
Weapons: none. Enclosed. A hive taxi, route-car or staff car. No firing ports; occupants must open a window or hatch 
to attack. Suits maintained roads and broad service tunnels.
Cargo Hauler
Huge wheeled vehicle
AC 12 | HP 70 | DT 5 | Speed 40 ft | Handling −1
Crew 1 D | Passengers 2 | Cargo 3 tonnes | Controlled
Weapons: none. Enclosed cab; open cargo bed. Six additional passengers may ride exposed in the bed, replacing 1 
tonne of cargo. This does not provide reinforced Ogryn accommodation.
Hive Outrider Bike
Large wheeled vehicle
AC 13 | HP 30 | DT 0 | Speed 80 ft | Handling +2
Crew 1 D | Passengers 1 | Cargo 50 kg | Controlled
Weapons: none. Exposed. Driver needs one free hand for the controls and can use a one-handed personal weapon 
normally. Passenger can use personal weapons. Neither position accommodates an Ogryn.
Armoured Utility Truck
Huge wheeled vehicle
AC 15 | HP 90 | DT 5 | Speed 50 ft | Handling 0
Crew 1 D, 1 G | Passengers 8 | Cargo 1 tonne | Scarce
Weapons: turret heavy stubber (G). Enclosed; two firing ports. Reinforced bay accommodates Ogryns at three spaces 
each. Use for prison vans, militia carriers and hardened convoy trucks.
Scout Sentinel
Large walker
AC 15 | HP 65 | DT 5 | Speed 40 ft | Handling +1
Crew 1 D | Passengers 0 | Cargo 100 kg | Rare
Weapons: forward multi-laser (D). Exposed cockpit. Turns in place; ignores difficult terrain from rubble, shallow mud 
and stairs wide enough for its feet. No wall-climbing or Ogryn accommodation.
Taurox
Huge tracked carrier
AC 16 | HP 95 | DT 10 | Speed 60 ft | Handling 0
Crew 1 D, 1 G | Passengers 10 | Cargo 500 kg | Rare
Weapons: turret autocannon with Twin-Linked (G). Enclosed; two firing ports. Ignores difficult terrain from rubble and 
shallow mud. Ogryns use three passenger spaces; normal crew stations are human-sized.
